first_page_native_text:
When will election results be available at the precinct polling location? 
Per regulation, after all ballots cast at a polling location have been processed, poll workers 
will print a tally slip from the voting machine for each precinct and post it at the polling 
location for public observation. This typically happens by 8:30 p.m. 
Please note that the precinct tally slip posted at the polling location will not include: 
●​ Early and absentee ballots processed at the Central Tabulation Facility 
●​ Ballots that need to be hand-counted 
●​ Specific write-in votes 
Why are some outlets able to report election results much sooner? 
Campaign volunteers and members of the media are welcome to visit polling locations to 
wait for unofficial results to be posted in person. As a result, some news outlets and 
campaigns may report results earlier than the Election Department. This is because certain 
campaigns have the resources to assign volunteers to all 275 precincts, allowing them to 
view and report the printed results that are publicly posted at each location. 
When will the results from Central Tabulation be available? 
Processing and tabulation of ballots began in advance, during the week before Election Day, 
and will continue through Election Day. All early and absentee ballots processed by 5 p.m. 
on the Friday before Election Day will be tabulated at City Hall. 
To obtain results from the tabulators used at the Central Tabulation Facility, each of the 275 
precincts must be closed out individually. Under the law, the process of closing precincts 
cannot begin until after 8:00 p.m. on Election Day. 
The results from each precinct processed at the Central Tabulation will be posted in a 
publicly accessible area within the Election Department as soon as all precincts have been 
closed out. These results will also be posted online on the Unofficial Results page under the 
header “Central Tabulation.” 
We expect that this will occur by approximately 9:30 p.m. 
Online Posting of Unofficial Results 
When will Election Night results be uploaded to the city's website? 
Unofficial Election Night results will be uploaded to our website as soon as they are 
available. We expect to begin posting precinct results by 10 p.m. Results will continue to be 
uploaded by precinct throughout the night, until all precincts have reported.
